line: Strong and gentle go together. A Japanese judo master in San Francisco got judo's highest rank at 98. Her motto: "Be Strong, Be Gentle, Be Beautiful in Mind, Body, and Spirit."
credit: Keiko Fukuda · Soko Joshi Judo Club
